steps.title: Top up your BakıKart
steps.sub: Look at the top-up machine on your left
hints: First we put money on the card. The top-up machine is on your left.
Look for the glowing machine on your left.
Turn left. Look at the glowing machine and hold your look for a moment.

steps.title: Tap your card at the turnstile
steps.sub: Look at the turnstile in front of you
hints: Now we go through the turnstile. Touch the card to the green reader.
Look for the glowing turnstile in front of you.
Look straight ahead at the glowing reader and hold your look for a moment.

steps.title: Find the train to {to}
hints: Read the station names on each sign. Which sign shows {to}?
Look at the glowing sign towards {terminus}.

steps.title: Get off at {to}
hints: This is {to}. This is our station!
Look at the glowing doors to get off.
The doors are open. Look at the doors and hold your look for a moment to get off here.
